title: Looking ahead: Microsoft Scout desktop app
summary: Microsoft Scout is transitioning to Autopilot, a cloud-based personal agent. Scout desktop app enters maintenance mode on September 30, 2026, while Autopilot begins private preview rollout the same day. Users can continue using Scout until Autopilot is available. Admins should inform users of this change.
body:
[What and why]

Microsoft Scout is now Autopilot (see our blog for more details). Autopilot is an always-on, cloud-based personal agent with its own identity, permissions, and access to M365 apps & tools. Your Autopilot reports to you, taking work off your plate and moving it forward, with enterprise-grade security from day one.

Autopilot will expand in private preview on 9/30, with broad availability by end of year. As of 9/30, the Scout desktop app will move into maintenance mode. Current Scout customers can continue using the Scout desktop app, while also experimenting with Autopilot as it becomes available.

As we get closer to broader Autopilot availability, we will provide additional information around the Scout desktop app timeline. We are working to bring local and browser capabilities to Autopilot, and anticipate an overlap period in Frontier Public to enable a transition between the two products.

[Rollout Schedule]

- Scout Desktop App enters maintenance mode: September 30, 2026- Autopilot starts rolling out to customers in private preview: September 30, 2026 [Impact on Your Organization]

Who is affected

- All customers using the Microsoft Scout desktop app Platforms / Services

- Microsoft Scout local desktop app (Windows/macOS) - GitHub Copilot (required for AI credit billing) What will happen

- Microsoft Scout desktop app enters maintenance mode, with no additional capabilities added to the application- Autopilot starts rolling out across private preview [Action Required / Recommendations]

Admin actions (required)

- Inform users that Microsoft Scout will move into maintenance mode on September 30, 2026User actions

- Continue using the Scout desktop app until Autopilot is available for your organization.
